findings.title: Messenger form fitted to its receiver
findings.claim: The focus ties an envoy's form to the community it would address: an angel is sent to an angelic earthly population, while wider messenger objections make the human counterpart newly visible.
findings.mechanism: The plural مَلَائِكَةٌ names the imagined residents and singular مَلَكًا رَسُولًا the envoy; يَمْشُونَ and مُطْمَئِنِّينَ place those residents in an embodied, settled earth-scene, and لَنَزَّلْنَا ... مِنَ السَّمَاءِ عَلَيْهِم maps the sender, route, and recipients. In 25:7, an ordinary messenger's eating and market-walking is paired with a demand for an angel; 6:9 describes an angelic envoy becoming human for human addressees; 43:60 repeats the possibility of angels inhabiting earth. These triggers meet the focus's earth-to-heaven axis and sender-recipient relation, making messenger form a question of receiver fit.
findings.reader_payoff: The angel condition becomes a local fit test: the imagined angelic community receives an envoy of its own kind, and the wider objections show why a human community is addressed through embodied human messengership.
findings.containment: The focus remains a conditional with its plain condition and consequence intact. The wider parallels support receiver-fit here without establishing a universal rule or a surah-wide thesis. The 25:63 walking-on-earth text is a boundary case: its supplied wording links walking to a peaceful reply to ignorant speech and does not itself establish messenger fitness. The م ل ك cohesion reading is a qualified structural color across the plural/singular pair, not a replacement gloss for angel. The physical low-ground facet of ط م ن and the divine-to-human delivery facet of ن ز ل are not asserted: the focus has settled participial wording, hypothetical angel recipients, and no described bending or message content.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers are grounded by the fully resolved QAC-analysis bridge, and the cited 25:7, 6:9, 43:60, and 67:15 texts are supplied exactly in the connection registry. Reader-walk material nominates the synthesis and has legacy_unbound trust; its unverified 17:94/96 claims are excluded.
